llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers and their dependents for medical expenses related to specified major ailments.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicant must be a building/construction worker (unorganised worker) who is a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka, at least 18 years old, with at least 90 days of work in a year, or their dependents, and must suffer from a major ailment specified in the scheme.
